snippet.title: LIFTED | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Get LIFTED! Play as slacker Ari, the accidental wingman in his professor's manic, love-fueled time heist. Swing, climb, and puzzle through history to outsmart rival tomb raiders in a cinematic '80s blockbuster adventure!

Coming to Steam and Steam Deck on July 22nd! Wishlist and join the adventure today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184020?utm_source=YT_RDA
